start.title: The Nazirite Promise
start.text:
An angel told your parents of you.
No razor must ever touch your hair.

choices.text: Mock the old vow as foolish
Honor the vow set apart for God
choices.feedback: Judges 13:5 — Samson was to be a Nazirite, set apart for God from birth, and no razor was to ever touch his head.

choices.text: Hide the vow from everyone
choices.feedback: What is set apart must be lived.

mock_consequence.title: He Set You Apart
mock_consequence.text:
The vow is not a chain but a calling.
Walk in the gift He gave you.

choices.text: Honor the vow set apart for God

hide_consequence.title: Live It Openly
hide_consequence.text:
A hidden vow grows weak in shadow.
Let the Lord be seen in you.

choices.text: Honor the vow set apart for God

vineyard.title: Lion on the Road
vineyard.text:
A roar splits the vineyard air.
The Spirit rushes upon you.

choices.text: Run and hide among the vines
Beg the lion for mercy
choices.feedback: Stand in the strength He gave.

choices.text: Stand and trust the Spirit's strength
choices.feedback: Judges 14:6 — The Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon Samson, and he tore the lion apart with his bare hands.

run_consequence.title: Stand in His Power
run_consequence.text:
The Spirit did not come for fleeing.
Turn and face the beast.

choices.text: Stand and trust the Spirit's strength

beg_consequence.title: Rise, Chosen One
beg_consequence.text:
He chose you to deliver Israel.
Do not bow to lion or fear.

choices.text: Stand and trust the Spirit's strength
choices.feedback: You rise to your full height.

philistine_clash.title: Philistines Press In
philistine_clash.text:
They oppress your people daily.
The Spirit stirs again.

choices.text: Make peace and bow to their gods
Strike them down with God's strength
choices.feedback: Judges 15:14-15 — The Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon Samson, and he found a fresh jawbone of a donkey and struck down a thousand Philistines.

choices.text: Boast and challenge them alone
choices.feedback: His arm wins, not your pride.

bow_consequence.title: Serve the Lord Alone
bow_consequence.text:
Their idols are wood and stone.
Fight only in His name.

choices.text: Strike them down with God's strength

boast_consequence.title: Give Him the Glory
boast_consequence.text:
Boasting empties what He fills.
Fight humbly and let Him win.

choices.text: Strike them down with God's strength

delilah_meet.title: Delilah Whispers
delilah_meet.text:
"Tell me where your strength lies."
Her voice is honey and snare.

choices.text: Reveal the secret of your hair
Guard the vow and walk away
choices.feedback: Judges 16:4-6 — The Philistine rulers asked Delilah to discover the source of Samson's great strength.

choices.text: Lie again and stay in her arms

lie_consequence.title: Flee Temptation
lie_consequence.text:
Each lie pulls you closer to ruin.
Leave her chamber for good.

choices.text: Guard the vow and walk away

guard_to_betrayed.title: Heart Worn Down
guard_to_betrayed.text:
Day after day she presses you.
At last your weary heart breaks.

choices.text: Tell her the secret in weariness
choices.feedback: The vow falls with your words.

betrayed.title: The Razor at Dawn
betrayed.text:
You wake — your braids are gone.
The Spirit has departed from you.

choices.text: Curse God for leaving you
Repent quietly in the dark mill
choices.feedback: Judges 16:19-20 — Delilah had Samson's hair shaved off, and the Lord had left him.

choices.text: Blame Delilah for everything

curse_consequence.title: He Still Hears
curse_consequence.text:
Even chained and blind, He listens.
Turn your heart back to Him.

choices.text: Repent quietly in the dark mill

blame_consequence.title: Own Your Vow
blame_consequence.text:
She tempted, but you chose to speak.
Confession is the first strength.

choices.text: Repent quietly in the dark mill

temple_summon.title: Brought Before Dagon
temple_summon.text:
They mock you between the pillars.
Your hair has grown back unseen.

choices.text: Beg the crowd for your freedom
Pray once more for the Lord's strength
choices.feedback: Judges 16:28 — Samson called to the Lord, asking for strength one last time to avenge his two eyes against the Philistines.

choices.text: Stay silent and accept defeat

beg_crowd_consequence.title: Cry to Heaven
beg_crowd_consequence.text:
The crowd has no mercy in them.
Only One can answer now.

choices.text: Pray once more for the Lord's strength

silent_consequence.title: One Last Calling
silent_consequence.text:
Israel still groans under Philistia.
Finish your judgeship in faith.

choices.text: Pray once more for the Lord's strength

ending_redeemed.title: Let Me Die With Them
ending_redeemed.text:
The pillars groan, the temple falls.
In death you save more than in life.
